items.name: Able Tea
items.description: Recovers Burnt Health and Burnt Stamina, and cures Infections instantly.

items.name: Ableroot
items.description: An essential ingredient to advanced medicines.

items.name: Alpha Jerky
items.description: Salted alpha meat that rots very slowly, while retaining the special meat's qualities.

items.name: Alpha Sandwich
items.description: Combined bread and alpha meat, which keep the meat's combat-enhancing properties.

items.name: Ambraine
items.description: An herb that, when smoked, mitigates the effects of heat and volcanic ash. However, it causes long lasting side effects...

items.name: Angel Food Cake
items.description: A delicious dessert that helps your Discipline.

items.name: Antique Eel
items.description: A River Eel, sometimes found in mountainous regions.

items.name: Azure Shrimp
items.description: Rare crustacean coveted by fisherman for its mana-restoring properties but that can make one ill when eaten raw.

items.name: Bagatelle
items.description: A corrupting, but delicious dessert

items.name: Baked Crescent
items.description: A cooked Golden Crescent. Rots more slowly.

items.name: Battered Maize
items.description: Maize coated with delicious salty Torcrab Egg Yolk.

items.name: Bird Egg
items.description: Large Pearlbird egg that carries a chance of disease when eaten raw. Eggs provide both health and stamina recovery over time.

items.name: Bitter Spicy Tea
items.description: Concoction that instantly cures infections, protects against the cold and restores Burnt Stamina.

items.name: Blood Mushroom
items.description: Peculiar toadstool that gives headaches when eaten raw, but is an ingredient in health-restoring elixirs.

items.name: Boiled Azure Shrimp
items.description: Cooked crustacean coveted for its mana-restoring qualities.

items.name: Boiled Cactus Fruit
items.description: Mushy fruit that, after being boiled, offers an immediate jolt of stamina.

items.name: Boiled Crawlberry
items.description: Boiled Crawlberries that rot slower than usual.

items.name: Boiled Dreamer's Root
items.description: Increases resistance to cold weather and cures the common cold.

items.name: Boiled Gaberries
items.description: Boiled fruit that provides a bit of nutrition and rots more slowly.

items.name: Boiled Miasmapod
items.description: Boiled octopus that is less toxic but with lower restorative qualities. It also instantly cures infections.

items.name: Boiled Purpkin
items.description: Boiled Purpkins that rot slower than usual.

items.name: Boiled Turmmip
items.description: Boiled root that increased its mana-restoring properties. It is no longer reinvigorating, however.

items.name: Boiled Veaber Egg
items.description: A Veaber Egg, cooked on a campfire, ridding it of disease. A staple food for Harmattan's mages.

items.name: Boozu's Meat
items.description: Raw meat that resists corruption. May make you sick if eaten raw.

items.name: Boozu's Milk
items.description: Raw milk from a female Boozu.

items.name: Boreo Blubber
items.description: Thick fatty oil. Fortifies and rejuvenates the body and stomach, but can cause Indigestion.

items.name: Bouillon du Predateur
items.description: Soup which restores stamina and increases the physical damage one deals to foes.

items.name: Bread
items.description: Basic food that can be bought in any city, as many recipes use this ingredient.

items.name: Bread Of The Wild
items.description: Special dish of Enmerkar that is unequaled in healing wounds over time. It also grants the Warm boon and an increase in stealth.

items.name: Cactus Fruit
items.description: Heavy desert fruit that re-invigorates and protects against the sun.

items.name: Cactus Pie
items.description: Dish of invigorating cactus fruit and bread that helps against the heat when eaten.

items.name: Cheese Cake
items.description: This healthy dessert also boosts Corruption resistance

items.name: Cierzo Ceviche
items.description: Dish of raw Rainbow Trout that keeps the fish's mana-restoring and elemental resistance attributes.

items.name: Cipate
items.description: A crustless meat pie with layers upon layers of meat. Provides excellent healing over time.

items.name: Clean Water
items.description: Drinking water restores stamina over time and removes the Burning status. It can be filled at fountains or in natural bodies of water.

items.name: Common Mushroom
items.description: Bland mushroom which restores little hunger, often found in dank caves.

items.name: Cooked Alpha Meat
items.description: Piece of very nutritious and fortifying meat.

items.name: Cooked Bird Egg
items.description: Pearlbird egg boiled over a campfire, removing the risk of disease.  Eggs provide both health and stamina recovery over time.

items.name: Cooked Boozu's Meat
items.description: Tasty meat that increases resistance to Corruption.

items.name: Cooked Jewel Meat
items.description: Iridescent steak of a rare bird that increases one's movement speed.

items.name: Cooked Larva Egg
items.description: Hardened exotic egg that rots more slowly than its raw counterpart.

items.name: Cooked Meat
items.description: Slab of meat grilled over a campfire, removing any risk of disease.

items.name: Cooked Torcrab Egg
items.description: A Cooked Torcrab Egg, free of diseases.

items.name: Cool Rainbow Jam
items.description: A chilly jam that provides some Barrier, Mana regeneration, and Heat Resist.

items.name: Crabeye Seed
items.description: Poisonous seed that, when grilled, is the first step in creating usable poisons.

items.name: Crawlberry
items.description: Corruption-bearing berries that grow on climbing vines.

items.name: Crawlberry Jam
items.description: Long-lasting gooey gelatin, good for stamina, but full of Corruption.

items.name: Crawlberry Tartine
items.description: Crawlberry Jam, spread on top of bread.

items.name: Crysocolla Beetle
items.description: A Volcanic beetle that lives in grease and oil.

items.name: Crystal Powder
items.description: Refined mana crystal used to craft powerful equipment. Consuming this powder restores mana, burnt mana, and burnt stamina. However, it burns maximum health until one sleeps again.

items.name: Cured Pypherfish
items.description: The toxins have been cleansed out of the meat, leaving behind protective qualities.

items.name: Diadème de Gibier
items.description: Special dish from Abrassar, allowing one to run fast and without pause.

items.name: Dreamer's Root
items.description: A root full of safely edible Mana, with latent medicinal potential.  Instantly cures Leywilt.

items.name: Dry Mushroom Bar
items.description: Mushrooms pounded into a bar shape. It restores a bit of maximum health.

items.name: Egg
items.description: Fresh egg from various creatures.

items.name: Fish
items.description: Fresh fish, can be cooked.

items.name: Food
items.description: Generic food item.

items.name: Food Waste
items.description: Diseased mush that is what remains when a cooking recipe fails.

items.name: Fresh Cream
items.description: Thick, delicious cream used in cooking. Provides Corruption resistance.

items.name: Frosted Crescent
items.description: A Golden Crescent, rolled in Frosted Powder. Protects against the heat.

items.name: Frosted Delight
items.description: A rare chilly delectable treat. Provides heat resistance, Barrier, and high Stamina regeneration.

items.name: Frosted Maize
items.description: A head of Maize, rolled in Frosted Powder. Protects against the heat.

items.name: Fungal Cleanser
items.description: Medicinal mushroom dish that removes poison and diseases.

items.name: Funnel Beetle
items.description: A Volcanic Beetle that naturally turns heat into cold as sustenance.

items.name: Gaberries
items.description: Common berry that only offers a small amount of nutrition and will quickly rot unless cooked.  As a fruit, these berries restore stamina over time.

items.name: Gaberry Jam
items.description: Crushed berries boiled into nutritious syrup, with warming properties.

items.name: Gaberry Tartine
items.description: Gaberry jam thinly spread on Bread, used to multiply the effects of jam into several portions.

items.name: Golden Crescent
items.description: A delicious fruit enjoyed by Sirrocan nobility.

items.name: Golden Jam
items.description: Mashed and preserved Golden Crescent.

items.name: Golden Tartine
items.description: Golden Jam, spread across bread, to make more food portions out of it.

items.name: Gravel Beetle
items.description: Scarab, found in mineral ores, whose resin hardens one's body from Impacts.

items.name: Greasy Tea
items.description: Recovers Burnt Health, and begins the process of curing Ambraine Withdrawal.

items.name: Grilled Crabeye Seed
items.description: Seed that becomes more toxic after being cooked and can be crafted, using linen, into a poisonous weapon coating.

items.name: Grilled Eel
items.description: A crunchy fillet of cooked Eel. Cures Weaken.

items.name: Grilled Manaheart Bass
items.description: A grilled Mana-filled fish fillet. Cures Sapped.

items.name: Grilled Marshmelon
items.description: Tender fruit, boiled to reveal its anti-poison properties.

items.name: Grilled Mushroom
items.description: Crumbling fungus that barely provides nutrients.

items.name: Grilled Nightmare Mushroom
items.description: Grilling this mushroom has converted the poison into a substance that increases awareness.

items.name: Grilled Pypherfish
items.description: A mana-heavy cooked fish. The toxins have been cooked into the meat...

items.name: Grilled Rainbow Trout
items.description:
Highly prized fish filet that shimmers brightly.
It restores mana and increases your resistance against elemental damage.

items.name: Grilled Salmon
items.description: Fish cooked over a campfire, removing any risk of disease.

items.name: Grilled Torcrab Meat
items.description: Spicy, but safe Torcrab Meat.

items.name: Grilled Woolshroom
items.description: Crudely cooked mushroom that, when eaten, muffles the sound of one's footsteps.

items.name: Healing Water
items.description: Water that has been fortified with healing roots. Recovers HP over time instead of Stamina.

items.name: Iced Tea
items.description: Recovers Burnt Mana, provides the Cool Boon and begins the process of curing Indigestion and Meeka Fever.

items.name: Jerky
items.description: Salted meat that rots very slowly.

items.name: Larva Egg
items.description: Eggs of exotic insects, with diverse restorative capacities.  Eating it raw carries a chance of disease.

items.name: Leyline Water
items.description: Water that glows with magical energy.

items.name: Luxe Lichette
items.description: Special dish of the Chersonese which restores a fair amount of stamina and a large amount of health.

items.name: Maize
items.description: A staple food for laborers and travellers alike. Quite filling.

items.name: Maize Mash
items.description: Typical Worker's food. Provides health regeneration and Discipline.

items.name: Manaheart Bass
items.description: A fish that has evolved to thrive in a Mana-Rich environment.

items.name: Marshmelon
items.description: Heavy marsh fruit that restore far more stamina than Gaberries. These raw melons gain anti-poison properties when boiled.

items.name: Marshmelon Jelly
items.description: Translucent spread of delicious fruit jam. The concentrated melon confers an immense stamina recovery.

items.name: Marshmelon Tartine
items.description: Melon jelly thinly spread on bread, making several rations, each full with stamina-restoring properties of a jar of marshmelon jam.

items.name: Meat
items.description: Raw meat from various creatures.

items.name: Meat Stew
items.description: Filling but ordinary dish made with whatever meat and plants are at hand, with a pinch of salt.

items.name: Miasmapod
items.description: Rare marsh octopus, which closes wounds but poisons the eater.  It also instantly cures infections.

items.name: Miner's Omelet
items.description: Filling omelet that is a good way to use Common Mushrooms to cook into a decent dish.

items.name: Mineral Tea
items.description: Concoction that increases impact Resistance and cures indigestion. It also restores burnt Health.  It takes hours, after drinking this, to fully recover from an indigestion.

items.name: Mushroom
items.description: Edible mushroom.

items.name: Needle Tea
items.description: Concoction that helps with the heat and indigestion. It also restores burnt stamina.  It takes hours, after drinking this, to fully recover from an indigestion.

items.name: Nightmare Mushroom
items.description: A poisonous mushroom that can stimulate the mind, when carefully cooked.

items.name: Ocean Fricassee
items.description: Superior egg and fish dish with healing properties which restore health, stamina, and mana.

items.name: Ochre Spice Beetle
items.description:
Uncommon reinvigorating insect that lives in plants and is used in advanced recipes.
Eating this insect protects from the cold.

items.name: Popped Maize
items.description: A delightful salty snack, good for filling an empty stomach.

items.name: Pot-au-Feu du Pirate
items.description: Salted fish soup is more restorative and nutritious than fish alone

items.name: Pouding Chomeur
items.description: A warming traditional food.

items.name: Poutine
items.description: A famous traditional comfort food of the northern tribes, invented completely by accident. Hot, filling, and delicious. Increases attack and impact, and protects against the cold.

items.name: Pungent Paste
items.description: Odorous paste which restores your maximum health and stamina, allowing you to continue adventuring without sleep. It also instantly cures infections.

items.name: Purpkin
items.description: A large sweet vegetable that grows in ground filled with dormant Corruption.

items.name: Purpkin Pie
items.description: Bursting with energy, but full of Corruption.

items.name: Pypherfish
items.description: A toxic fish. Requires some work to make safely edible.

items.name: Ragoût du Marais
items.description: Special dish of the Hallowed Marsh that immediately heals wounds, unlike most food.  It also gives the Possessed boon.

items.name: Rainbow Peach
items.description: A rare volcanic fruit. Has properties that resist elements.

items.name: Rainbow Tartine
items.description: Rainbow Jam, spread across bread, to make more food portions out of it.

items.name: Rancid Water
items.description: Contaminated water, not safe to drink.

items.name: Ration Ingredient
items.description: Ingredient used for travel rations.

items.name: Raw Alpha Meat
items.description: Potent meat from Prime animals, which rots quickly and carries diseases while raw.

items.name: Raw Jewel Meat
items.description: Iridescent flesh of a rare bird which increases one's movement speed.

items.name: Raw Meat
items.description: Edible meat that should be cooked first, as it rots quickly and carries diseases while raw.  As a type of meat, this food restores health over time.

items.name: Raw Rainbow Trout
items.description: Shimmering fish that restores mana but can make one ill when eaten raw.  It also increases your resistance to all elemental damage.

items.name: Raw Salmon
items.description: Common fish that is edible raw but rots quickly and can make one ill.  Fish and seafood have mana-restoring properties, and are quite important in a mage's diet.

items.name: Raw Torcrab Meat
items.description: A spicy hunk of Torcrab Meat.

items.name: River Water
items.description: Water from a river.

items.name: Roasted Krimp Nut
items.description: Roasted nut that increases the metabolism.

items.name: Salt Water
items.description: Salty seawater.

items.name: Savage Stew
items.description: Elaborate stew using alpha meat and a gravel beetle, which gives impact resistance as well as adding impact to one's attacks with the rage status

items.name: Seared Root
items.description: Fire-Infused plant, seared again in fire.  It will slowly remove common cold with its heat.

items.name: Smoke Root
items.description: Fire-infused plant that grows in burnt lands.

items.name: Soothing Tea
items.description: Concoction that cures the common cold and restores burnt Mana.  It takes hours, after drinking this, to fully recover from the cold.

items.name: Sparkling Water
items.description: Sparkling water that provides enhanced Stamina Recovery.

items.name: Spiny Meringue
items.description: Thorny dessert with high health and stamina restorative properties.   It also helps against the sun when eaten.

items.name: Star Mushroom
items.description: Celestial toadstool which restores mana and is an ingredient in magic-restoring elixirs.

items.name: Stringy Salad
items.description: Mixture of vegetables and mushrooms that heals a bit, but can fill an empty stomach.

items.name: Sulphuric Mushroom
items.description: A combustible mushroom that is key to many alchemical recipes.

items.name: Toast
items.description: Burnt slice of bread.  It fills the belly, but does little else.

items.name: Torcrab Egg
items.description: A Torcrab's Egg. Cook before eating.

items.name: Torcrab Jerky
items.description: Spicy, long-lasting, strengthening Jerky.

items.name: Torcrab Sandwich
items.description: A lightly grilled Torcrab Sandwich, a Warrior favourite.

items.name: Travel Ration
items.description:
Bland biscuit used when traveling from one region to the next, though it can be eaten as normal food as well.
This food has no properties apart from being filling, and can even be made using Survival Crafting.

items.name: Turmmip
items.description: Bulbous root vegetable with mana-restoring properties.

items.name: Turmmip Potage
items.description: Chunky soup that has mana-restoring properties, and will slowly heal the common cold.

items.name: Vagabond's Gelatin
items.description: A jam containing the properties of several regional jams. Provides unparalleled benefits.

items.name: Vagabond's Tartine
items.description: Vagabond's Gelatin, spread across bread, to make more food portions out of it.

items.name: Veaber's Egg
items.description: An egg from the unusual Veaber species. The yolk has magical properties.

items.name: Vegetable
items.description: Fresh vegetable.

items.name: Warm Boozu's Milk
items.description: Wholesome Boozu milk that is safe to drink, and warms the drinker.

items.name: Water
items.description: Clean drinking water.

items.name: Woolshroom
items.description: Airy mushroom strands that, when eaten, muffle the sound of one's footsteps.
